description: Stage 2 plan emission currently allows the planner to widen ## Touch Set beyond intent.scope without an explicit recorded scope expansion, causing unexpected Stage 3 overlap queues.
goal: Enforce at Stage 2 plan validation in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/stages/plan.py (using helper apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/stages/plan_scope_guard.py so both stay strictly within 200-line module limits and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json) that every path listed in ## Touch Set (excluding provenance paths plans/, executions/, holon-knowledge/, intents/) is contained in intent.scope unless an explicit recorded scope expansion entry is present on the plan or intent. Fail Stage 2 cleanly when unrecorded out-of-scope touch-set paths appear, before entering Stage 3 admission. Add unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/stages/test_plan_scope_guard.py verifying unrecorded out-of-scope touch-set paths fail Stage 2 while in-scope paths, provenance paths, and explicit recorded expansions pass, passing uv run pytest and uv run task lint. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Checking plan touch sets against intent.scope at Stage 2 exit stops unannounced scope creep from dragging shared hub files into Stage 3 admission conflicts.
acceptance_criteria: Stage 2 (flow/stages/plan.py / plan_scope_guard.py) fails closed at plan validation before Stage 3 admission when any file in ## Touch Set lies outside intent.scope (excluding provenance paths plans/, executions/, holon-knowledge/, intents/), unless an explicit recorded scope expansion is present.

Unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/stages/test_plan_scope_guard.py verify that unrecorded out-of-scope ## Touch Set paths fail Stage 2, provenance paths and recorded expansions pass, and uv run pytest + uv run task lint pass with no docstrings or disallowed comments.
